post.description:
Public: create the church, its first home group and its ADMIN, who leads it. The email
address is the one invited. Rate limited per IP like sign-up.

Public: the church and the domain the invitation went to. The token is in the body, so it
never reaches an access log of the API. Rate limited per IP; every failure is the same `404`.

get.description: Public (no login): the login screen needs the right words before anyone signs in.
Test builds of the mobile app. Any logged-in person; nobody else can see them.
The APK of one published version, with the bearer token like every other request.

schema.title: Response Forgot Password Api V1 Auth Forgot Password Post

post.description: Public. Creates a PENDING person in the chosen home group and tells its leader.

get.description: Public: the open churches by name. No contact details.

put.description:
The OWNER replaces the ADMIN of another church with one of its members, in one
transaction: the successor becomes the ADMIN directly (keeping any group they lead), the old
ADMIN stays as a provider or a searcher, set by the OWNER, and nobody is flagged. If the old
ADMIN leads a home group it passes to `group_successor_id`, or they keep leading it as a
VERIFIER when they are alone in it. The OWNER's own church changes ADMIN only by a handover
(`409 owner_church`).

get.description: Public: the open home groups of an open church, each with its leader's name.

put.description: Replace the freelancer's whole label set. Skill levels attach to a specific skill.

schema.title: Response Replace Labels Api V1 Freelancers Me Labels Put
Response List Unavailability Api V1 Freelancers Me Unavailability Get
Response List Vouches Api V1 Freelancers Me Vouches Get

post.description:
The only place a freelancer's mobile number is returned to anyone else.

Every call is recorded, and each work host has an hourly and a daily limit.

Public: the church and group a link leads to, for the sign-up screen. The token is in the
body, not the path, so it never reaches an access log of the API. Rate limited per IP; every
failure (no such link, expired, revoked, group closed) is the same `404`.

get.description:
An ADMIN sees the open requests of their church, the OWNER of every church; everyone else
their own requests. Paged: `limit` (1 to 100, default 50) and `offset`.

post.description:
Ask to start a home group. An ADMIN or the OWNER start it at once, and the answer holds
the group; if they lead a group now, `successor_id` names who leads it from now on (or it
closes when they are its only member: `409 successor_required` otherwise).

Create the group and move the requester in as its leader (a VERIFIER unless higher). If the
requester leads a group now, `successor_id` names who leads it from now on, or the old group
closes when the requester is its only member (`409 successor_required` otherwise).

The leader of a home group closes it, being its last member (`409 group_not_empty`
otherwise), by moving into another open group of the church, in one transaction. A VERIFIER
becomes a provider or a searcher, recorded as set by the church's ADMIN; an ADMIN or the OWNER
keeps their status (`former_leader_status: keep`). The group is kept, with the date it closed,
and links to it and moves into it end. `404` for anyone but its leader.

put.description:
Replace the leader of a home group, or hand on your own, with a successor from its members
(PENDING or above), in one transaction. The successor becomes a VERIFIER (unless higher); a
stepping-down VERIFIER stays as a provider or a searcher, set by you, and nobody they admitted
is flagged. An ADMIN of the group's church or the OWNER; `404` for any other. An ADMIN or the
OWNER hand on only their own group, and keep their status (`former_leader_status: keep`).

schema.title: Response List Labels Api V1 Labels Get

patch.description: Rename or deactivate a label. Labels are never hard-deleted.

delete.description:
Close your own account (this is the stores' "delete account"). The password is asked
again. The record stays, the personal details go. A leader steps down first; the OWNER hands
over; a revoked person stays on their church's list.

get.description:
The caller. A person gets the view of the church trust model (a revoked person too, to see
why they have no access); the older accounts keep their older answer until they are gone.

schema.title: Response Me Api V1 Me Get

put.description: Change your own name or mobile number (a field left out keeps its value).

While pending: choose another home group (even in another church) or another status to
apply for. Vouches already received still count; a newly chosen leader is notified.

post.description:
A searcher asks to become a provider. They keep searching, make a vouch link in the usual
way, and their leader is notified. `409 not_searcher` for everyone else; asking again changes
nothing.

get.description:
Newest first. Clients poll this (every 60 seconds while open); `unread_count` is for a
badge. A notification holds a kind and the person it is about, never a number.

Whether you have a vouch link that still works. The link itself is shown only when it is
made, because only a hash is kept; make a new one to share it again.

post.description:
A new vouch link; the one before it stops working. The token is shown once. For a PENDING
applicant, or a SEARCHER who applies to provide (`409 not_applying` otherwise).

get.description: The moves that concern you, as the member or as the leader of either group, newest first.

post.description:
Ask to move to another home group of your church. Asking is your agreement; the leader of
the group you leave and the leader of the group you join are told and must agree too. A leader
steps down through succession before moving (`409 leads_a_group`).

The leader of either group agrees (the member agreed by asking). The member moves in the
same transaction as the last agreement. `404` for anyone it does not concern.
The member or the leader of either group ends an open move; the other side is told.

get.description: Approved organisations by name, so work hosts can filter a search by who vouches.

schema.title: Response Directory Api V1 Organisations Get

post.description: Vouch for a freelancer. The vouch stays pending until the freelancer accepts it.

get.description:
Every church (open ones first), with its ADMIN and counts of open groups, members and
revoked people. Paged: `limit` (1 to 100, default 50), `offset`.

post.description:
Invite the ADMIN of a new church. The church exists once they accept. The link token is
shown once; only a hash is kept. There is no mail service yet, so the OWNER shares the link.

get.description: The undecided invitations, newest first. Paged: `limit` (1 to 100, default 50), `offset`.

post.description:
Close a church other than your own: it, all its home groups and all its members' accounts
are closed together and kept, with the date, for the history. Nobody is revoked or flagged;
the church's revoked people stay on its list, so they still cannot sign up again. Former
members sign up again in another church. `409 owner_church` for the OWNER's own church.

get.description: The open proposal that concerns you (as the outgoing OWNER or the chosen ADMIN), if any.

post.description:
Propose to hand the OWNER role to the ADMIN of another church. Name a new ADMIN for your own
church and a new leader for your group (each may be left out only when nobody else is in the
church or group, and you then keep that role). Nothing changes until the chosen ADMIN accepts;
one proposal is open at a time (`409 handover_open`).

The chosen ADMIN accepts. In one transaction they become the OWNER (and stay the ADMIN of
their own church), the OWNER's church gets its new ADMIN and its group its new leader, and the
outgoing OWNER becomes a provider or a searcher (or keeps a role nobody can take over).
Either side withdraws an open proposal; the other side is told.
Rate a freelancer 1 to 10. One rating per work host and freelancer; use PUT to change it.

get.description: The reports you may run. Organisations see only reports limited to their own data.

schema.title: Response List Reports Api V1 Reports Get
Response List Schedules Api V1 Reports Schedules Get

put.description: Change when a report runs. The worker picks the change up within a minute.

get.description: Run a report now and return it as JSON or CSV. Nothing is stored.

post.description: Run a report for a window and keep its files. Repeating a finished run does nothing.

get.description: Find freelancers. Freelancers with at least one skill are listed; a rate is not needed.
PENDING applicants in scope, the most vouched first. No phone numbers.
The links into your home group that still work (the tokens are not shown again).

post.description: A new link into your own home group. The token is shown once; only a hash is kept.

get.description: Admitted people in scope, by name. Filter by `status` or `home_group_id`.

One person in scope, with their history, chain of trust and mobile number. Each call is
logged (who looked at whom, never the number); `404` for anyone out of scope.

post.description:
Admit an applicant as a searcher or a provider. A provider needs a live vouch from
someone besides you (`409 not_enough_vouches`).
Close an application. Nobody is revoked, and the person can sign up again.

An ADMIN (of the person's church) or the OWNER moves an admitted member to another open home
group of the church, without the agreements a move by request needs. A leader steps down first
(`409 leads_a_group`); the member is told, and so are both leaders.

Clear the re-check flag of a person in scope. You become the new link in their chain of
trust. `409 not_flagged` if there is no flag.

put.description:
Revoke a person in scope who is below you, or reinstate a revoked one into a home group
(`home_group_id`). A leader is replaced first (`409 successor_required`). A revocation made
by a higher leader cannot be undone by a lower one (`403 status_not_allowed`).

post.description:
Who a vouch link is for. The token is in the body, not the path, so it never reaches an
access log of the API. Rate limited per IP; every failure is the same `404`.

Vouch for the person the link is for: once each, never for yourself, and at most
`VOUCH_MAX_PER_DAY` a day.

delete.description: Take back your vouch, until the applicant is admitted.

get.description: Liveness: the process is up. Also tells which build is running.
Readiness: the database answers.
